scripts.setup:env: if not exist .env copy .env.example .env & if not exist exporter\.env copy exporter\.env.example exporter\.env
scripts.setup:logrotate: pm2 install pm2-logrotate@2.7.0 && pm2 set pm2-logrotate:max_size 10M && pm2 set pm2-logrotate:retain 30 && pm2 set pm2-logrotate:compress true && pm2 save
scripts.build: bun run build:agent && npm --prefix exporter run build
scripts.prestart: bunx pm2-startup install && npm run setup:env
scripts.start: bun --env-file=.env src/check-port.ts && bun run build && pm2 startOrReload ecosystem.config.js --env production && pm2 save
